svg.text: The 8-point FFT network: bit-reversed inputs, 3 stages, natural-order outputs
Stage 2 holds E[0..3] in rows 0–3 (ink) and O[0..3] in rows 4–7 (purple).
Gold label ×W under a box: the twiddle multiplies that value (the bottom input). Red line: subtract.
Thick lines: the k = 1 butterfly of L17. Values rounded to two decimals.
